purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Import Depot Activity XML Interface details.
features: This function allows the user to generate XML Interface.

events.description: Generates the XML Interface for the selected BL records.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more BL records using the check boxes, clicks the ☰ icon at Voyage level in Depot Activity and selects "XML Interface".
